name: Titanium-Case Rounded-Square Smartwatch
description: A minimalist rounded-square smartwatch with a matte titanium-grey aluminum case, a sapphire-coated black display glass, a woven stone-grey nylon strap, and a polished stainless-steel side crown.
materials: matte titanium-grey aluminum case, sapphire-coated black display glass, woven stone-grey nylon strap, polished stainless-steel side crown
primaryColors: titanium grey, stone-grey nylon, black display glass
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the case, case back, crown, or strap; never render a second crown or button, or a visible pixel grid on the display glass; never swap the nylon strap for a metal bracelet or leather band Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the matte titanium case finish, stone-grey nylon strap weave, single side crown, sapphire display glass, and completely plain unmarked case back must read identically in every angle, same case proportions and crown position throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
